title: Gauth Eyestalk

sources.title: Suspension of Gauth Eye
markers: | description = '''Suspension of Gauth Eye''' is an [[Alchemy|Alchemical Extraction]] . It can be combined with any [[Alchemy#Extractions|Sublimate]] to create {{SmRarityItem|Elixir of Battlemage's Power}}.

sources.title: Elixir of Battlemage's Power
markers: | description = '''Elixir of Battlemage's Power''' is a rare [[elixir]] that increases the potency of spells by granting 3 stacks of {{Cond|Arcane Acuity}} which persist until the next long rest.

summary: Combine three Gauth Eyestalks into Suspension of Gauth Eye, then combine the suspension with any Sublimate to brew Elixir of Battlemage’s Power.

fields.Use: Combine three Gauth Eyestalks into Suspension of Gauth Eye, then combine the suspension with any Sublimate to brew Elixir of Battlemage’s Power.
fields.Base value: 17 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
